turns.replyText:
My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?

When tracking shows delivered but the package hasn't been found, it's worth checking a few spots first. Look around your delivery address (front door, side door, back door, garage, mailroom, porch, or other secure locations), and check with household members, neighbors, or building staff if applicable. Sometimes the delivery scan posts before the package is actually retrieved, so allowing 24 to 48 hours after the delivered scan is recommended.

If your order shipped in multiple boxes, each box has its own tracking number and delivery timing, so one package may be delivered while others are still in transit.
